items_all.title: TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
items_all.summary: TSMC is reportedly weighing a price increase of up to 20% for its CoWoS advanced packaging technology as Nvidia’s Blackwell and upcoming Rubin chips intensify pressure on capacity. Equipment deliveries now reportedly take up to eight months, while separate wafer-price increases of 5% to 10% are expected in 2027, with some customers potentially facing total cost increases of up to 25%.
items_all.title_original: TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
items_all.title_en: TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
items_all.title_zh: 据报道，由于 Nvidia Blackwell 和 Rubin 芯片对封装产能造成压力，台积电考虑将 CoWoS 价格上涨 20%

items_all.summary_zh: 据报道，由于 Nvidia 的 Blackwell 和即将推出的 Rubin 芯片加大了产能压力，台积电正在考虑将其 CoWoS 先进封装技术的价格上涨最多 20%。据报道，设备交付目前需要长达 8 个月的时间，而预计 2027 年晶圆价格将单独上涨 5% 至 10%，一些客户可能面临高达 25% 的总成本上涨。

items_all_raw.title: Police are reportedly pulling motorists over because AI algorithms deem their driving patterns 'suspicious'
items_all_raw.summary: An ACLU report claims police are increasingly using AI to analyze license plate-reader data and flag motorists based on travel patterns, raising concerns that innocent drivers could be pulled over because an algorithm deemed their movements suspicious.
items_all_raw.title_original: Police are reportedly pulling motorists over because AI algorithms deem their driving patterns 'suspicious'
items_all_raw.title_en: Police are reportedly pulling motorists over because AI algorithms deem their driving patterns 'suspicious'
items_all_raw.title_zh: 据报道，警方将驾车者拦下，因为人工智能算法认为他们的驾驶模式“可疑”
items_all_raw.title_bilingual: 据报道，警方将驾车者拦下，因为人工智能算法认为他们的驾驶模式“可疑” / Police are reportedly pulling motorists over because AI algorithms deem their driving patterns 'suspicious'
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 美国公民自由联盟的一份报告称，警方越来越多地使用人工智能来分析车牌读取器数据，并根据出行模式标记驾车者，这引发了人们的担忧，即无辜的司机可能会因为算法认为他们的行为可疑而被拦下。
